title: Inventory Filter
description: Filter for a specific inventory based on its availability status. `id` is dependent on the industry offering the inventory (e.g., product/variant ID from shopping catalog, dish ID from food menu).

id.description: The stable, opaque identifier of the item that MUST be Business-resolved (e.g., product or variant ID in shopping, or dish ID in food ordering).

availability_status.description: Availability status of the inventory requested at the location. Well-known values: `in_stock`, `backorder`, `preorder`.
